about: The vocabulary and the decision table that turn several independent sources into one recommended action per 1 km block. blocks.py reads its thresholds and rules from this file, and the app draws its evidence graph from it, so the code, the documentation and the picture cannot drift apart.

object_types.Source: A dataset from one instrument or one mapping effort.
object_types.Block: A 1 km square of ground inside a site.
object_types.Observation: One number about a block, taken from one source.
object_types.State: A yes or no statement about a block, decided by a rule over observations.
object_types.Action: What a restoration team could do about a block, decided by a rule over states.

thresholds.note: The HH noise floor of each orbit is read from validation.json (noise_floor_hh_<track>), not fixed here.

states.title: On mapped peat
states.why: Drying matters most where the soil is peat: dry peat burns and loses carbon.

states.title: Dried
states.why: At L-band, HH carries the echo from the ground under the vegetation and falls as that ground dries. Two orbits that look from opposite sides at different times of day must both see it.

states.title: Burnt
states.why: A thermal detection from another instrument, independent of the radar.

states.title: Did not come back after the rain
states.rule: left_asc > noise floor and left_desc > noise floor
states.why: Wet ground brightens again within days. Ground that stays dark after rain on both orbits lost more than surface moisture.

states.title: Canopy not recovering
states.rule: burnt and hv_left_asc >= hv_left_db and hv_left_desc >= hv_left_db
states.why: HV comes from the woody canopy. Rain does not bring back branches, so HV that stays low where fire was detected points to lost vegetation.

states.title: Near a canal
states.why: Canals are what drain peat. The map of canals is incomplete, so far from a mapped canal does not mean undrained.

actions.title: Assess the burn
actions.advice: Fire was detected on peat here. Check the ground for lost canopy and plan rewetting and replanting.

actions.title: Rewet first
actions.rule: on_peat and dried and not burnt and not_back
actions.advice: Peat that dried on both orbits, has not burned, and stayed low after the rain. A first candidate for canal blocking.

actions.title: Watch
actions.rule: on_peat and dried and not burnt and not not_back
actions.advice: Peat that dried and came back with the rain. It will dry again next season: a place to patrol.

actions.title: No action flagged
actions.advice: Steady, or outside mapped peat. Fire outside peat is still shown.

confidence.rule: Start at 1 when the action's own rule holds. Add 1 for each condition in the action's stronger_if list that also holds. 3 or more is high, 2 is medium, 1 is low.

extra_conditions.strong_fall: fall_asc and fall_desc both at least twice fall_db

caveat: A screening result. It says where to look first, never what is certainly there. No ground measurements were used.
